description.value: Dolly's Reach is a family-run wood-fired pizza restaurant in Quesnel, BC, operating since 2017 with two generations of family expertise in horticulture and food craft. The menu leans heavily on produce from their own farm and local growers, featuring house-made doughs, sauces, and seasonal cheesecakes. Cyclists will find a welcoming outdoor patio surrounded by the garden that supplies the kitchen, offering cocktails, mocktails, and hearty farm-to-table meals.
